outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays (log2 expression color scale) on tissue sections, not a bar/summary plot of averaged replicate data. Heatmap-type visualizations are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs only; there is no plot summarizing data with averages, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a scatter plot showing every individual TCGA tumor sample (n=500 LUSC, n=512 LUAD) as a dot with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual data points are inherently displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with the individual replicate data points (n=3 per group) plotted as dots on top of each bar.
